claude_proposed_widenings.name: extend_spell_target_count
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The secondary-target clause modifies how many creatures a specific named spell may target when cast through this feature, bounded by proximity to the primary target. No existing v4 atom or grant_spell_access field models this. grant_spell_access.targetRestriction restricts targets; it cannot add them. scale_target_count scales by slot level, not by feature. A new atom or a new field on grant_spell_access is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you cast either spell, you can target a second creature with it if that creature is within 10 feet of the first target.
